messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick update — we pushed a refresh to international PTO guidance, travel per diem caps, and leave coordination for folks outside NA. Effective Apr 1. See summary below and FAQ link.
Jon (HRBP): Thanks Asha — big Q: what happens to unused PTO for EMEA next year?
Asha (People Ops): Good Q. We're moving from a calendar-year carryover to a 6-month use window for EMEA/APAC balances — up to 5 days can carry, remaining goes to the consolidated leave bank. We'll auto-convert on Apr 1; you'll see balances reflected in Workday and in the payroll export.
michelle: Will this affect payroll accruals? Need to update local employment letters.
ryan (Finance): We'll handle accrual changes. Note that country statutory rules may override policy — Finance + Legal will publish a country matrix by end of week.
Asha (People Ops): Travel update: per diem caps for EU and APAC travel increased by ~10% to match recent expense trends; receipts still required for expenses over local threshold (~$75 USD eq). Emergency evacuation coverage expanded for APAC. Full details in the policy doc.
lisa: Is there guidance for visa/immigration support for business travel?
Asha (People Ops): Yes — new step added to the travel request flow: "Visa/immigration required?" If yes, People Ops will coordinate with Legal; please allow 3–4 weeks lead time.
eng-bot: Policy doc updated — https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/international-pto-and-travel (automated)
john: Code of conduct refresher is in the doc too. Quick reminder: if you witness misconduct, report via hr@redwood.com or anonymously via the hotline. Managers are required to escalate within 48 hrs.
Asha (People Ops): Also added: a limited parental leave top-up option for certain small-office markets (APAC L1) — 6 weeks at 80% pay top-up. Employees must opt in via the leave form by Apr 30.
sarah (People Ops): Action items: 1) Review the FAQ and policy page. 2) Update your Workday PTO accrual elections if needed. 3) Managers — check team leave plans and approve any carryover requests before Apr 15. 4) If traveling, attach visa docs to the travel request.
michelle: Can international contractors opt in to the parental top-up?
Asha (People Ops): Top-up is limited to regular employees at this time. Contractors remain eligible only for statutory/local benefits unless otherwise governed by a local agreement.
Jon (HRBP): Thanks everyone. If helpful we can do a 30-minute Q&A drop-in tomorrow at 9am PT for managers and local HRBPs.
Asha (People Ops): Drop-in link: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/pto-travel-qna — will record and post notes.
lisa: Thanks! Sharing with EMEA all-hands.
ryan (Finance): Finance will publish a one-pager about accrual mechanics and examples by EOD Friday.
Asha (People Ops): TL;DR — effective Apr 1: new carryover window for EMEA/APAC, per diem increases, expanded evacuation coverage in APAC, parental top-up opt-in, updated visa workflow, and Code of Conduct reminder. Questions -> #people-ops or hr@redwood.com :megaphone: 
eng-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x12, :eyes: x4
Asha (People Ops): Filing note: we'll email payroll teams and post an all-hands banner on Apr 1.
john: Appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
